verifications.claim: The official application for 2027 Masters tickets opens on June 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "you can apply between June 1st and June 20th" (R1); "applications... open June 1 and close June 20" (R4); "Applications for the 2027 Masters open on June 1" (R6); "open from June 1-20, 2026" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the application opens June 1, 2026 for 2027 tickets.

verifications.claim: The official application for 2027 Masters tickets closes on June 20, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "June 1st and June 20th" (R1); "open June 1 and close June 20" (R4); "open on June 1 and will be open through June 20" (R6); "June 1-20, 2026" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the close date as June 20, 2026.

verifications.claim: The official application for 2027 Masters tickets is via tickets.masters.com.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "create one ahead of time at tickets.masters.com"
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly specifies the official site as tickets.masters.com.

verifications.claim: Applicants can enter a lottery for practice rounds costing $125–$150.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "$125 for Monday and Tuesday, $150 for Wednesday" (R3); "$125 for practice rounds" (R4); "Practice round tickets ranged from $120 to $150" (R5); "Practice rounds (Monday, Tuesday): $125... (Wednesday): $150" (R6); "$125... and $150 for Wednesday" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm lottery for practice rounds at exactly those 2026 prices, applicable as estimate for 2027.

verifications.claim: Applicants can enter a lottery for daily tournament tickets costing $160.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "$160 for each of the tournament days" (R3); "First round (Thursday) $160... Final round (Sunday) $160" (R5); "$160" for Thu-Sun (R6); "Daily tournament tickets (Thursday-Sunday) were $160 each" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state $160 for 2026 tournament days via lottery.

verifications.claim: Winners are notified in late July.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "you'll find out in July with payments open from late that month" (R1); "inform those who have been selected in late July" (R4); "payments starting in late July" (R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state notification in late July.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "April 5-11"... "Monday-Wednesday, April 5-7... Thursday-Sunday, April 8-11" (R7, R8); R4 specifies tournament Thu Apr 8-11 within that week
verifications.reasoning: R7/R8 directly state full Masters dates April 5-11 including practice rounds.

verifications.claim: Estimated cost based on 2026 is ≈$150 for tournament days.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "$160 for each of the tournament days" (R3); "$150 for tournament rounds" (R4, possible error); "$160" Thu-Sun (R5,R6,R7)
verifications.reasoning: Majority of sources state exactly $160 for 2026 tournament days; ≈$150 contradicts.
